heroSummary: KUSD has published four English instructional calendars for 2027–28. Boundary-school K–12 students start September 1, boundary 4K starts September 8, and Frank Elementary starts August 3 for K–5 and August 10 for 4K. KUSD lists June 6 as the last half day for all students, while Frank Enrichment Weeks continue June 12–15 and June 19–22. ACT and PreACT dates remain TBD in the high school calendar.

customSections.label: ACT and PreACT Dates Are Still TBD
customSections.content: The high school PDF defines the attendance rule but prints both assessment dates as TBD. On ACT day, juniors will test with early release while grades 9, 10, and 12 do not attend. On PreACT day, grades 9 and 10 will test with early release while grades 11 and 12 do not attend. Check the KUSD assessment calendar before planning transportation.

customSections.label: Frank Continues Beyond the Common Last Day
customSections.content: KUSD lists June 6 as the fourth-quarter endpoint and last half day for all students, but Frank's alternate calendar shows Enrichment Weeks June 12–15 and June 19–22, with Frank closed June 16 and June 23. These are Frank-only program dates, not an extension for other KUSD students.

customSections.label: Weather Delays and School Closures
customSections.content: KUSD generally announces emergency schedule changes by 5 a.m. through district text alerts, its website, Channel 20, social media, and local media. A two-hour delay cancels early childhood, speech impact, and 4K sessions; a full closure also cancels after-school and evening activities.

calendarFaqs.q: Does KUSD use one calendar for every school?
calendarFaqs.a: No. KUSD publishes separate boundary elementary, middle, and high school calendars, plus an alternate calendar for Frank Elementary. Shared closures align, but conferences, releases, assessments, and some school dates differ.

calendarFaqs.q: When does KUSD start school in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Boundary-school K-12 students start Wednesday, September 1, 2027, and boundary 4K starts September 8. Frank Elementary K-5 starts August 3 and Frank 4K starts August 10.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for KUSD in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: KUSD lists Tuesday, June 6, 2028, as the last half day for all students. Frank Elementary separately lists Enrichment Weeks June 12–15 and June 19–22.

calendarFaqs.q: When are KUSD Winter and Spring Break in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 20–31, 2027, with classes resuming January 3. Spring Break runs March 27–31, 2028, with classes resuming April 3; Good Friday is a separate district closure on April 14.

calendarFaqs.q: Do all KUSD elementary students leave early on Fridays?
calendarFaqs.a: The official boundary elementary and Frank PDFs mark Fridays as early-release days. Regular Friday events are not included in the downloadable files because dismissal time varies by school; confirm hours with your school.

calendarFaqs.q: Which conference dates apply to LakeView K-8 and Ruth Harman?
calendarFaqs.a: KUSD groups LakeView K-8 and Ruth Harman with the middle-school evening conference schedule and excludes them from the boundary-elementary conference release and no-school dates.

calendarFaqs.q: When are the KUSD ACT and PreACT dates in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: The official high school PDF lists both assessment dates as TBD. Families should use KUSD's assessment calendar when the district posts confirmed dates.
Yes. KUSD has published the four 2027–28 instructional calendars, but future-year dates may still be revised. ACT and PreACT dates are still TBD, so check KUSD’s official calendar page for updates.

sourceReviewDetails: All four one-page English PDFs were downloaded, rendered, and visually reviewed because the year page itself contains only the download links.
Shared closures, quarter dates, professional-learning days, and the common last half day were reconciled across elementary, middle, and high school PDFs.
Frank's August start, Enrichment Weeks, workdays, conferences, and closures were checked separately against the alternate-calendar PDF.
ACT and PreACT remain TBD in the official high school PDF and were deliberately not assigned invented dates.

All .ics files are one-time imports. Regular Friday early-release events are not included because dismissal times vary by school; families should confirm published hours and later schedule changes with their school.
